title: Reference — make it like this sample video
summary: The sample decides the rhythm, transitions, camera and text slots (reference_to_plan.py reads them from analyze_reference.py's report.json); the user's footage and words fill them. This playbook sets no genre numbers: every limit below is a wide net that only stops a broken plan, and pacing_checker.py --reference REPORT replaces it with the sample's own numbers.
signals: the user supplies a sample video to imitate
the footage can be of any kind: the sample, not the genre, sets the style

runtime.why: The runtime follows the sample (reference_to_plan.py --duration); this band only stops a broken plan.

structure.purpose: one scene per shot of the sample

music.mood: the sample's: measure it with analyze_reference.py (music.bpm, loudness)

compliance: The sample's logo, music, footage, typeface and customer work stay the sample's: take its rhythm and structure, not its assets
Every number, price and claim on screen comes from the user or the documents, never from the sample's text
A genre's own claim rules still apply to the words (pass --genre ID to reference_to_plan.py to copy that checklist)
Ask whether the video will be boosted as an ad: ad policies bar some formats the sample may use (before/after, absolute results)
